description: This file defines data classes representing chat messages, message content, pending tool calls, session entries, chat history, and attachments for a chat application within the 'ai.openclaw.app.chat' package.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a chat message with id, role, content, and optional timestamp.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Contains the content of a chat message, supporting text, mime types, file info, and base64 encoded data.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Represents a pending tool call with details like call id, tool name, arguments, start time, and error status.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Stores information about a chat session, including key, last updated timestamp, and display name.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: Maintains the history of a chat session including session key, id, thinking level, and list of messages.

classes.name: OutgoingAttachment
classes.description: Represents an outgoing file attachment with type, mime type, filename, and base64 data.
